text:
Alyssa: Heads-up — I landed a refactor PR that rehomes a bunch of optkit example files. I didn't catch all downstream refs, sorry. PR #4921
Jordan: Which refs are failing? CI caught broken links?
Alyssa: Yep. /optimize/examples links and some SDK snippet imports. The preview shows 12 404s.
Samir: Can you paste the list? I can do a quick redirect map + tiny patch to the snippets.
Alyssa: Here are the top offenders from the preview log:
- docs/examples/batching_v1.json -> removed
- docs/examples/kv_prefetch_example.py -> renamed
- docs/snippets/quant_profile_default.md -> moved to /optkit/quant-profiles

Jordan: If we add a data-driven sample map we can auto-redirect in the docs build. Small YAML and a template change.
Samir: Agreed. Proposed map (apply in docs/_data/optkit_sample_map.yml):
```yaml
- old: "examples/batching_v1.json"
  new: "examples/batching_smallseq_v2.json"
- old: "examples/kv_prefetch_example.py"
  new: "examples/kv-prefetch-python-0.3.py"
- old: "snippets/quant_profile_default.md"
  new: "optkit/quant-profiles/default.md"
```
Lee: I'll update the docs Sphinx template to consult that map and emit redirects for old paths. Minimal change.
Alyssa: Awesome. Also need to check JS/TS SDK snippets that import the old filenames — those live in src/snippets/js and src/snippets/py. I can grep and send a list in ~15m.
Samir: I'll take the Python snippets once you post the grep. Jordan, can you own the JS/TS ones?
Jordan: Yep. I'll open a small PR that updates imports and adds a short integration test to assert snippet import still builds.
Alyssa: Quick note on quant profile docs: we want to preserve old anchors if possible (redirect anchors -> new anchors). Lee, can the template keep #anchor fallback?
Lee: I can add a quick client-side fragment scroll fallback. Not ideal but will preserve links until we do canonical anchors.
Samir: I'll make the snippets patch and add a comment in each file to point to the new canonical path. Also include a one-line migration hint for users.
Alyssa: Perfect. Plan:
- Samir: patch python snippets + add comments (PR by EOD)
- Jordan: patch JS/TS + add import test (PR tomorrow morning)
- Lee: templating for redirects + anchor fallback (PR by EOD)
- Alyssa: follow-up with grep and run preview check once patches merged

docs-bot: Preview published: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/optkit/preview/4921 (12 link errors remaining) :eyes:

Jordan: I can pick off 6 of those link errors in the JS PR.
Samir: I'll take 5. That should leave 1 left which is the quant anchor path Alyssa mentioned.
Alyssa: I'll own the last one and confirm once the redirect map is live. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Lee: Cool. Tagging @integrations to watch the redirect template change for any CI flakiness.
Alyssa: Closing loop — once redirects are merged we should run a full linkcheck and then remove the old files from the repo in a follow-up so we don't regress.
Jordan: Agreed — prefer two-step (redirects, then delete).
Alyssa: OK will update PR description to reflect that workflow.
Samir: One small snippet nit — the kv-prefetch example needs a small import tweak for the new package layout. I'll include the diff in the PR.
Alyssa: Great. If anything blocks, drop notes here and we can do a quick sync.
